associations.shares: class shares with AOI-bootstrap 95% CI (AOI = sampling unit)
associations.test: mean(PERSISTENT) - mean(other), class labels permuted within AOI, 10000 draws, seed 48

classes.unit: cluster mean over its cells observed in the follow-up season; UNOBSERVED if < 50% of cells observed

clusters: the 174 SAR-tested Phase 22X clusters (8-connected candidates of the unchanged 22L rule); no new detection
interpretation: PERSISTENT = non-revegetating, mining-COMPATIBLE disturbance for review priority; roads, construction, quarries, dumps and slow fallows are all compatible; not a mining label
not_done: no threshold tuning, no model training, no TEST access, no accuracy metrics
optical: unchanged Phase 22L seasonal_graph (SCL 4/5, cloud prob < 40, NDWI < 0, brightness >= 0.04, >= 2 obs) for the follow-up season on the identical 22X AOI grids
